description: Simulates a circuit and returns the voltage across and current through every part once it settles, and names faults: a short circuit, nothing flowing, an LED over its current rating, a bulb too dim to light. Use this when the person has a circuit and asks "how much current goes through my LED?", "what voltage comes out of this divider?", "will this bulb light?", "will this burn out my LED?" or "does this circuit work?". Runs CircuitJS, a real circuit simulator with ideal parts, on a CircuitJS (falstad) circuit or a breadboardhub.com/sim link. Returns the readings, the faults and a link that opens the circuit running live. Takes 10 to 30 seconds. Daily limit per account; an API token raises it.

circuit.description: The circuit: CircuitJS (falstad.com/circuit) text, a "$" options line then one part per line such as "r 176 112 304 112 0 220" for a 220 ohm resistor (at most 20,000 characters), or a breadboardhub.com/sim link that carries one.
